## What's Changed
* Polish the command palette: Recent first, Create note and Ask AI actions, keycaps by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/702
* Collections: create from the empty state, layout-named views, 250 pt board columns by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/703
* Connections: one label per note, focus fades, peek cards, legend, empty state by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/704
* Settings: squircle nav, in-pane search filtering, lighter grouped cards by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/705
* Tags: hairline chips, dimmed paths, new # picker, dot stack in tables by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/707
* Folio: scope header, status icons and menu, row actions by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/708


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/compare/v0.9.6...v0.9.7-alpha.1
